business_problem: Counting 93 million clients globally and operating in over 51 countries, AXA is one of the world's leading insurance and asset management groups. The company joined the surge of generative AI, providing its 140,000 employees the power of this new era of AI with an emphasis on doing things securely and responsibly.
solution_summary: AXA, a leading insurance company, is taking a new step in its digital transformation with generative AI. Counting 93 million clients globally and operating in over 51 countries, AXA is one of the world's leading insurance and asset management groups. The company joined the surge of generative AI, providing its 140,000 employees the power of this new era of AI with an emphasis on doing things securely and responsibly. After crafting the overall functional architecture, a team of AXA experts collaborated with Microsoft, the company's long-term and trusted services provider The initial two months focused on prototyping, followed by a month of fine-tuning. By summer, the AXA Secure GPT application was rolled out for employees within AXA Group Operations present in 14 countries. The implementation centers on Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Studio, Azure to support enterprise knowledge search workflows.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Powers the generative assistant that helps employees search, summarize, and draft content.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Studio
solution_components.role: Provides the managed environment for building, evaluating, and governing AI applications.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Provides the underlying cloud infrastructure, identity, and managed services for the solution.
